$comment: Hand-written licence data for things neither cargo-about nor license-checker sees (DESIGN.md 4.11, 10.3). `text_file` names a file in tools/licenses/texts/. `notes` keys are package names; a trailing * matches a prefix. `fonts` renames npm font packages into the Fonts group. `exclude` drops npm packages that are not in the shipped bundle (patterns as for notes). `overrides` replaces fields of a generated entry (same key rules); `text_file` there also names a cached text.

Downloaded with your permission.name: FFmpeg
Downloaded with your permission.note: Runs as a separate process and is downloaded only after you say yes; it is never bundled with the app. Built from unmodified FFmpeg sources with --enable-version3 and without --enable-gpl or --enable-nonfree. The exact configure flags (ffmpeg/BUILD_CONFIG.txt) and the corresponding source tarball are published with every Smidge-Libraries release. See https://ffmpeg.org/legal.html.
